# pkg_regex: # majors = installed SDK majors the entry applies to. kind: removed | renamed | inert | deprecated | changed-default | platform-gated. when: optional unit predicate (platform:macos, role:library ...).

name: profilesSampleRate
message: Removed in 9.0. Use options.configureProfiling { $0.sessionSampleRate = ...; $0.lifecycle = .trace } (not on tvOS/watchOS/visionOS).

name: enableAppHangTrackingV2
message: Removed in 9.0 (app hangs V2 is iOS/tvOS only and no longer a flag).

name: enableLogs
message: No-op since 9.27.0: manual logger calls are not gated by it, so setting it false does NOT stop SentrySDK.logger output.

name: attachScreenshot
message: Declared only for iOS/tvOS/visionOS: a COMPILE ERROR on native macOS. Remove it or wrap in #if os(iOS) || os(tvOS) || os(visionOS).

name: attachViewHierarchy
message: iOS/tvOS/visionOS only: compile error on native macOS.

name: sessionReplay
message: Session Replay is not available on native macOS: compile error. Official support is iOS only.

name: waitForFullDisplay
message: SentryTracedView(waitForFullDisplay:) exists only on iOS/tvOS: compile error on macOS.

name: enableFileIOTracking
message: There is no such option; it is enableFileIOTracing.
